title: Yahrtzeit: Barbara Atlas (ברכה בת אברהם) — 6th
description: Observed by the Meer, Rosen, and Storz families, on 2 Tamuz. A cherished icon of the Jewish community in Birmingham, Alabama, and a teacher who educated three generations of children over her 50-year career.
sourceExcerpt: By the Meer, Rosen, and Storz families in memory of our beloved aunt, ברכה בת אברהם, ז''ל, Barbara Atlas, on the occasion of her 6th yahrtzeit on 2 Tamuz. Barbara was a cherished icon of the Jewish community in Birmingham, Alabama. She was an exceptional teacher who was responsible for educating 3 generations of children over her 50-year career. She instructed them in Hebrew and limudei kodesh and prepared them for their bar/bat mitzvot. Barbara is deeply missed by her family and her community. May her memory be for a blessing.

title: Yahrtzeit: Gershon Young (גרשון טודרי בן שיעה) — 11th
description: Observed by the Litz, Harris, and Sharfman families. A Shoah survivor and family patriarch remembered for his kindness, love, and complete emunah in Hashem.
sourceExcerpt: In loving memory of our beloved father, grandfather and great-grandfather, Gershon Young - גרשון טודרי בן שיעה, ז''ל, on his 11th yahrtzeit on 4 Tammuz, June 19, 2026. The patriarch of our family, he exemplified a life filled with kindness, love and complete emunah in Hashem. A survivor of the Shoah, he constantly yearned for his lost loved ones. He is truly missed. May his neshama have an aliyah. - With love, The Litz, Harris, and Sharfman familes.
